# RenSetu — The Green Energy Directory

> A free, independent directory helping homeowners in Delhi NCR find trusted local dealers for rooftop solar, rainwater harvesting, EV charging, biogas and other green upgrades. Includes free planning calculators and plain-language guides. No commissions on purchases.

## Solutions
Ten green upgrades covered, each with typical cost, available subsidy, expected saving and payback for Delhi NCR:
- Rooftop Solar: https://rensetu.in/solutions/solar/
- Solar Water Heater: https://rensetu.in/solutions/heater/
- Rainwater Harvesting: https://rensetu.in/solutions/rain/
- EV Charging Setup: https://rensetu.in/solutions/ev/
- Battery & Backup: https://rensetu.in/solutions/battery/
- Terrace Wind Turbine: https://rensetu.in/solutions/wind/
